place.summary: Mong Kok functions primarily as a connector in Hong Kong's visitor network. Its strongest observed source market is TH. It receives notable inbound connections from Hong Kong Disneyland. Visitors often continue to Hong Kong Disneyland.

opportunity_cards.title: Frequent companion: Hong Kong Disneyland
opportunity_cards.detail: Mong Kok frequently appears alongside Hong Kong Disneyland, suggesting cross-promotion or route packaging potential.

opportunity_cards.title: Strong onward link to Central
opportunity_cards.detail: Visitors often continue from Mong Kok to Central, with relatively strong journey experience.
